Notes. Names, roles and prefab components come from the embedded catalog (Valheim 1.0.20). A Type.field key is only read by the game when the object has the HasFields switches and the prefab has that component — overrides for other components ("foreign") are harmless junk. Names you add or solve are remembered in this browser and can be exported. Chunk worlds are read-only here; rotations are quantised to half degrees in the game's chunk format.
